__provenance.why: Turnover, defensive-touchdown and own-recovery shapes: no turnover existed in any recorded fixture, so DEF attribution and the turnover role split had nothing to assert against. Two real SAFETIES added Sep 2026: both show item.team == end.team (the scoring defense, same rule as a turnover) while isTurnover is false, and one carries roles passer,penalized — the shape that credited the grounding quarterback with his own safety.
